documentTypes.name: Agreement

documentTypes.name: Deed

documentTypes.name: Heads of Terms

documentTypes.name: Side Letter

documentTypes.name: Novation Agreement

documentTypes.name: Defence

documentTypes.name: Witness Statement

documentTypes.name: Expert Report

documentTypes.name: Skeleton Argument

documentTypes.name: Certificate

documentTypes.name: Shareholders' Resolution

documentTypes.name: Demand Letter

documentTypes.name: Requisition

documentTypes.name: Undertaking

documentTypes.name: Procedure

documentTypes.name: Handbook

documentTypes.name: Code of Conduct

documentTypes.name: Terms & Conditions

documentTypes.name: Privacy Notice

documentTypes.name: HMRC Return / Election

documentTypes.name: Regulatory Notification

clientAndMatter.description: Segmentation of clients by strategic value and relationship depth

values.name: Platinum
values.description: Strategic client — panel / key account; senior relationship partner assigned; quarterly reviews

values.name: Gold
values.description: Significant client — regular work; relationship partner assigned; annual reviews

values.name: Silver
values.description: Established client — recurring instructions; supervised by senior fee earner

values.name: Bronze
values.description: Occasional client — ad hoc instructions; standard supervision

values.name: Referral
values.description: Referred by intermediary or panel firm; referral terms apply

values.name: One-off / New
values.description: First or single instruction; standard new client checks; enhanced supervision

clientAndMatter.description: The nature of the retainer and how the matter is managed

values.name: Transactional
values.description: A discrete deal or transaction with a defined completion event (e.g. M&A, conveyancing, financing)

values.name: Advisory
values.description: Ongoing or project-based legal advice without a transaction (e.g. regulatory guidance, opinion)

values.name: Contentious
values.description: Dispute or litigation matter — court, tribunal, arbitration, or ADR

values.name: Regulatory / Compliance
values.description: Regulatory filing, investigation, or compliance programme

values.name: Drafting / Documentation
values.description: Template creation, precedent drafting, or document review programme

values.name: Corporate Support
values.description: Routine company secretarial, board support, or governance matter

values.name: Pro Bono
values.description: No fee; internal approval required; partner sign-off mandatory

clientAndMatter.description: How fees are charged to the client for this matter

values.name: Hourly Rate
values.description: Standard time-recorded billing at agreed hourly rates by level of fee earner

values.name: Fixed Fee
values.description: Agreed lump sum for defined scope; scope change protocol applies

values.name: Capped Fee
values.description: Hourly rate billing subject to an agreed cap; client notified before cap reached

values.name: Conditional Fee (CFA)
values.description: No-win no-fee arrangement; uplift agreed; client care letter to confirm

values.name: Damages-Based Agreement (DBA)
values.description: Fee contingent on recovery; regulated under DBA Regulations 2013

values.name: Retainer / Subscription
values.description: Monthly or annual fee for agreed services or hours of access

values.name: Blended Rate
values.description: Single agreed rate applied regardless of fee earner level

values.name: Pro Bono
values.description: No charge; recorded at nil for management information purposes

clientAndMatter.description: Matter-level risk assessment for supervision and conflicts purposes

values.name: Low
values.description: Routine matter; standard supervision; no unusual conflict or regulatory risk

values.name: Medium
values.description: Some complexity; enhanced review at key stages; senior sign-off on advice

values.name: High
values.description: Complex, novel, or high-value; partner supervision throughout; file review required

values.name: Critical
values.description: Regulatory, reputational, or major financial risk; COLP / COFA notification may be required

values.name: Conflict Flagged
values.description: Potential conflict identified; formal conflict check and waiver process in progress

values.name: Sensitive
values.description: Political, media, or reputational sensitivity; managing partner awareness required

values.name: Financial Services

values.name: Real Estate & Construction
values.description: Property developers, housebuilders, REITs, contractors

values.name: Technology & Digital

values.name: Healthcare & Life Sciences
values.description: NHS, pharma, medtech, private healthcare, biotech

values.name: Energy & Natural Resources
values.description: Oil & gas, renewables, utilities, mining

values.name: Retail & Consumer
values.description: Retail, FMCG, hospitality, leisure, food & beverage

values.name: Manufacturing & Industrial
values.description: Engineering, automotive, aerospace, chemicals

values.name: Public Sector & Charity
values.description: Local authority, central government, charities, education

values.name: Professional Services
values.description: Accountancy, consulting, architecture, other law firms

values.name: Private Individual
values.description: HNW individuals, family offices, private clients

values.name: Other / Mixed
values.description: Does not fit a single sector; or sector not yet classified

clientAndMatter.description: Indicative value or complexity bracket for resource planning and reporting

values.name: Micro
values.description: Under £10,000 estimated fees — typically fixed fee or short advisory

values.name: Small
values.description: £10,000 – £50,000 estimated fees — standard supervision

values.name: Medium
values.description: £50,000 – £250,000 estimated fees — senior oversight; budget review at 50% consumed

values.name: Large
values.description: £250,000 – £1,000,000 estimated fees — partner-led; monthly budget review

values.name: Major
values.description: Over £1,000,000 estimated fees — dedicated team; steering committee; regular client reporting

values.name: Undetermined
values.description: Fee estimate not yet established — to be updated within 10 working days of opening

crmAndRelationships.description: The nature of the individual or organisation in the firm's CRM

values.name: Client — Active
values.description: Currently instructing the firm on at least one open matter.
values.guidance: Check for open matters; client care obligations apply

values.name: Client — Dormant
values.description: Has instructed the firm previously but no active matter in the last 24 months.
values.guidance: Consider re-engagement; data retention review due

values.name: Client — Former
values.description: Has instructed the firm but relationship formally concluded; no expectation of return.
values.guidance: Conflict check still required; data retention policy applies

values.name: Prospect
values.description: An individual or organisation identified as a target for new business; not yet instructed.
values.guidance: No client care obligations yet; GDPR basis for holding data to be confirmed

values.name: Lead
values.description: A prospect who has made an enquiry or expressed interest in the firm's services.
values.guidance: Initial conflict check recommended; respond within agreed SLA

values.name: Referrer — Professional
values.description: An accountant, IFA, surveyor, or other professional who refers clients to the firm.
values.guidance: Referral agreement / terms may apply; track referrals received and reciprocated

values.name: Referrer — Client
values.description: An existing or former client who introduces new clients.
values.guidance: Thank-you protocol; no referral fee without SRA compliance

values.name: Referrer — Internal
values.description: A cross-referral from another team or office within the firm.
values.guidance: Cross-referral tracking; revenue credit allocation

values.name: Introducer
values.description: A third party who introduces work under a formal introduction agreement (e.g. broker, agent).
values.guidance: Introduction agreement required; FCA implications if regulated activity

values.name: Panel / Network Member
values.description: A fellow member of a referral network, law firm panel, or professional association.
values.guidance: Panel terms apply; reciprocal referral expectations

values.name: Opposing Counsel / Firm
values.description: A law firm or solicitor on the other side of a matter.
values.guidance: Conflict monitoring; professional courtesy obligations

values.name: Expert / Counsel
values.description: A barrister, KC, or independent expert instructed by the firm.
values.guidance: Track availability, rates, and areas of expertise

values.name: Supplier / Vendor
values.description: A firm supplying services to the firm (e.g. costs draftsman, process server, search agent).
values.guidance: Procurement terms; DPA data processor agreement may be required

values.name: Regulatory Body / Court
values.description: A court, tribunal, regulator, or public authority the firm deals with.
values.guidance: Not a commercial relationship; contact record for process purposes only

values.name: Media / Press
values.description: A journalist, publisher, or media contact.
values.guidance: All contact via marketing / managing partner; no unsanctioned comment

values.name: Potential Recruit
values.description: An individual being considered for employment or a lateral hire.
values.guidance: HR confidentiality; separate from client CRM if possible

crmAndRelationships.description: The current state of the firm's relationship with this contact

values.name: Target
values.description: Identified as a desirable contact or client; no relationship established yet.
values.guidance: Assign relationship owner; add to BD plan

values.name: Cold
values.description: No recent meaningful contact; relationship has lapsed or never properly developed.
values.guidance: Consider outreach campaign or remove from active pipeline

values.name: Warm
values.description: Some engagement (e.g. event attendance, newsletter open, social connection); not yet converting.
values.guidance: Nurture with relevant content; invite to events

values.name: Active
values.description: Regular meaningful contact; relationship is live and productive.
values.guidance: Maintain cadence; record touchpoints in CRM

values.name: Instructing
values.description: Currently giving instructions; at least one open matter.
values.guidance: Fee earner responsible for day-to-day; relationship partner for strategic oversight

values.name: Key Account
values.description: A strategically important client managed under a formal key account plan.
values.guidance: Key account plan in place; quarterly partner review; dedicated BD budget

values.name: At Risk
values.description: Signals of dissatisfaction, reduced instructions, or competitor approach detected.
values.guidance: Urgent relationship partner intervention required; escalate to managing partner if needed

values.name: Lost
values.description: Has moved instructions to a competitor or ceased using the firm.
values.guidance: Exit interview if possible; record reason; flag for potential reactivation

values.name: On Hold
values.description: Relationship paused by agreement (e.g. conflict, regulatory restriction, client request).
values.guidance: Review date to be set; do not contact without prior clearance

crmAndRelationships.description: Where a prospect or lead sits in the new business development pipeline

values.name: Identified
values.description: Added to the pipeline as a potential target; no contact made.
values.guidance: Assign to BD owner; set initial outreach date

values.name: Initial Contact
values.description: First contact made (e.g. meeting at event, introduction, cold outreach).
values.guidance: Log touchpoint; send follow-up within 48 hours

values.name: Qualified
values.description: Confirmed as a viable prospect with a genuine need and budget; fits firm's target profile.
values.guidance: Assign relationship partner; add to sector BD plan

values.name: Meeting / Pitch Scheduled
values.description: A formal introductory meeting or credentials presentation arranged.
values.guidance: Prepare credentials pack; confirm attendees and agenda

values.name: Proposal / Pitch Submitted
values.description: A formal proposal, tender response, or pitch document has been submitted.
values.guidance: Follow up within agreed timescale; note decision date

values.name: Panel / Preferred Status
values.description: Appointed to a panel or agreed as a preferred supplier without a specific matter yet.
values.guidance: Panel terms agreed; relationship partner to drive first instruction

values.name: First Instruction Received
values.description: First matter opened; prospect converts to active client.
values.guidance: Trigger client onboarding; assign client tier; update CRM status

values.name: Repeat Instructions
values.description: More than one matter received; relationship is established.
values.guidance: Review client tier; consider key account status if volume warrants

values.name: Stalled
values.description: Pipeline has stopped moving; no response or engagement for 60+ days.
values.guidance: Relationship owner to make direct contact; consider removing from active pipeline

values.name: Lost — No Instruction
values.description: Prospect has confirmed they will not instruct the firm on this occasion.
values.guidance: Record reason; keep warm for future if appropriate

crmAndRelationships.description: How this contact came to know the firm, or how they refer work

values.name: Existing Client Referral
values.description: Introduced by an existing or former client.
values.guidance: Highest quality source; acknowledge and thank promptly

values.name: Professional Referral — Accountant
values.description: Referred by an accountancy firm or individual accountant.
values.guidance: Track referrals in/out; reciprocate where appropriate

values.name: Professional Referral — IFA / Wealth Manager
values.description: Referred by an independent financial adviser or wealth manager.
values.guidance: Common for private client and tax work

values.name: Professional Referral — Surveyor / Agent
values.description: Referred by a surveyor, estate agent, or property consultant.
values.guidance: Common for real estate and construction work

values.name: Professional Referral — Other Law Firm
values.description: Referred by a firm that cannot or will not act (e.g. conflict, capacity, specialism).
values.guidance: Reciprocal referral expected; maintain relationship

values.name: Professional Referral — Other
values.description: Any other professional referral source (e.g. insolvency practitioner, banker).
values.guidance: Note profession and specific individual in CRM

values.name: Event / Conference
values.description: Met at a firm event, industry conference, seminar, or webinar.
values.guidance: Record event name and date; follow up within 48 hours

values.name: Website / Digital Enquiry
values.description: Inbound enquiry via website contact form, email, or digital channel.
values.guidance: Respond within agreed SLA; track conversion rate

values.name: Directory / Chambers / Legal 500
values.description: Found the firm via a legal directory listing.
values.guidance: Note directory and edition; useful for BD and directory submission evidence

values.name: Social Media / LinkedIn
values.description: Connected or enquired via LinkedIn or other social media platform.
values.guidance: Assign to BD owner; move to CRM within 24 hours

values.name: Panel Appointment
values.description: Appointed through a competitive tender or panel review process.
values.guidance: Note panel name, duration, and review date

values.name: Advertising / PR
values.description: Responded to firm advertising, press coverage, or PR activity.
values.guidance: Track campaign source for marketing ROI analysis

values.name: Alumni
values.description: A former employee or trainee who has instructed or referred work.
values.guidance: Alumni programme; maintain warm relationship

values.name: Cold Outreach
values.description: The firm proactively approached this contact without a prior introduction.
values.guidance: Note outreach method and date; manage GDPR basis carefully

values.name: Unknown / Not Recorded
values.description: Source not captured at the time of onboarding.
values.guidance: Prompt fee earner to update; aim for <5% unknown in CRM

crmAndRelationships.description: How actively and deeply this contact engages with the firm across all touchpoints

values.name: Advocate
values.description: Actively promotes the firm; provides references; speaks at firm events; refers regularly.
values.guidance: Highest value relationship; involve in key account planning; recognise and reward loyalty

values.name: Engaged
values.description: Regular contact; attends events; responds to communications; gives repeat instructions.
values.guidance: Maintain cadence; invite to premium events; consider thought leadership collaboration

values.name: Receptive
values.description: Opens communications; attends occasional events; responds when contacted.
values.guidance: Nurture with relevant content; invite to appropriate events

values.name: Passive
values.description: Receives communications but rarely engages; instructs occasionally.
values.guidance: Review contact preferences; consider targeted outreach

values.name: Disengaged
values.description: Not opening communications; no recent contact; at risk of lapsing.
values.guidance: Try alternative channel; consider removing from mailing lists if no response

values.name: Opted Out
values.description: Has requested to stop receiving marketing communications.
values.guidance: Comply immediately; remove from all marketing lists; retain in CRM for conflict purposes only

types.name: Intermediary

types.name: Lender / bank
